sources.title: SBDO1/SBD_o1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A 355M parameter GPT-2 model, built from scratch in PyTorch following Sebastian Raschka's Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch), starting from OpenAI's pretrained GPT-2 medium weights and instruction fine-tuned on the Stanford Alpaca dataset (52k instruction/response pairs).
